prompts.sky: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background layer for LopeKing, a side-scrolling action game set in a fallen Joseon Korean capital at night. Create a smooth high-resolution digital matte painting, NORMAL NON-PIXEL illustration with natural antialiasing, smooth brushwork, natural material shading. Absolutely NO pixel art, mosaic, dithering, block grid, game UI, text, lettering, people, characters or monsters. Unified restrained palette: soot charcoal, warm ink black, smoke grey, muted ash brown, faint desaturated bronze-orange embers. No blue-violet cast, no saturated blue, no green lights. Very subdued localized orange fire, no giant bright flames, no brilliant whites. Atmospheric cinematic ruin, gameplay readability more important than spectacular lighting. Orthographic side elevation, no foreground road receding to a vanishing point. This image is ONLY the opaque SKY plate, wide landscape 16:9, 1536x864 or larger. A dark smoky charcoal night sky, layered smooth ash-grey smoke clouds, faint small obscured moon high in the upper right (diameter about 6% image width, no halo), very subtle muted brown fire haze along the bottom fifth. No mountains, buildings, trees or ground. Very low contrast. Seamless quiet cloud shapes near left and right edges.
